raw.rationale: GDC-0068 (ipatasertib) is a potent pan-AKT inhibitor whose single-agent activity in 5-day PRISM viability screens is generally modest and not strongly lineage-selective, with the clearest enrichment expected in PI3K/AKT-pathway-dependent breast cancers (especially PIK3CA/PTEN-altered) and some other pathway-activated lineages. Base rates are low, so most lineages receive probabilities near the 0.2-2.5% background range, with modest elevations for breast and possibly ovary, gastric, and urinary tract.
